item.message: Model metadata for `deepseek-flash` not found. Defaulting to fallback metadata; this can degrade performance and cause issues.

item.text: I’ll compute the sum and count, then write the sorted values with a trailing newline.

item.command: /bin/zsh -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- output.txt ---'; cat output.txt; printf '%s\\n' '--- validation ---'; awk 'NR==1{sum="'$0} NR==2{count=$0} NR>2{values[NR-2]=$0} END{n=0; for(i=1;i in values;i++) n++; printf "count=%d, values=%d'"\\n\", count, n}' output.txt; [ \""'$(tail -c 1 output.txt | od -An -t u1 | tr -d '"' ')\" = \"10\" ] && echo trailing-newline=yes || echo trailing-newline=no"
